name: Photo strip
what: A photobooth strip pushes down in jerks, frame by frame, in black and white or colour, sways on the wall with a handwritten date, then slides back up - memories, a recap, friends.

learned_from.what: a photobooth strip pushing out frame by frame

motion: n pushes of 9 f (S-curve) + a 6 f stop with a tiny shake; sways 30 f (sine); slides back 14 f (accelerating)
